**Goal `ext-compiler`. Stages 1 to 4 are done; Stage 5 (the source section) has two of its three checks green.** The design is ADR 0246 § 3 and § 8 and the goal file's § *Standing decisions*. This goal has no record slot.

`nvs-ext`'s loader refuses a source file whose `namespace` is not under the class's own namespace (the class minus its last segment), naming the file: `Source::outside` in `crates/nvs-ext/src/source.rs`, called after the reserved-namespace check in `Loader::load_bytes`. It reads only the file's head, so `nvs-ext` takes no parser.

`nvs_hir::ExtensionClass` has a `source` field (`ExtensionFile { path, text }`), set on the manifest's class alone. The graph walk in `crates/nvs-hir/src/requires.rs` (`carried_source`) resolves a wanted name under that namespace to the carried file before it probes any `autoload` root. It loads the file with `SourceMap::add`, so the file has no path, and holds it to `check_file_shape`. **Nothing fills the field yet:** `nvs_types::ext_lib::hir_classes` sets it to empty, because the CLI threads manifests only (`Vec<Manifest>`).

The ledger fixture's `source/Ledger/Receipt.nvs.src` now opens with `<?nvs` and writes `Shop\Ledger::` with no leading `\`. `ledger.nvsx` and `ledger.sha256` were rebuilt with `NVS_WRITE_FIXTURES=1`.

items.text: **A class in a fixture extension's source section resolves and runs with no `autoload` line**: carry each extension's `Source` beside its `Manifest` from `read_manifests` (`crates/nvs-ext/src/load.rs:492`) through `crates/nvs-cli/src/extensions.rs:164` into `hir_classes` (`crates/nvs-types/src/ext_lib.rs:68`), which fills `ExtensionClass::source` on the manifest's class; `crates/nvs-cli/src/main.rs:2184` is where `nvs run` and `nvs check` build the classes. Then write `tests/conformance/ext/an-extension-source-class-resolves-with-no-autoload-line.nvst`, which loads `ledger` and calls `Shop\Ledger\Receipt::line`. Watch that IR and codegen accept a loaded file with no path. `rule:packaging/an-extension-package-carries-two-payloads`.

**`nvs check` types an extension call from the configured set** (Stage 6): check `nvs-cli` test `nvs_check_types_an_extension_call_from_the_configured_set` (`crates/nvs-cli/src/main.rs:2184`). `rule:packaging/extension-calls-are-statically-typed`.

backlog: `nvs test` and the language server do not read the set yet (Stage 6, `rule:packaging/extension-calls-are-statically-typed` § *Not on disk*).
An `autoload` or `require` line inside a carried source file is ignored rather than refused, because the file has no directory (`crates/nvs-hir/src/requires.rs`, the `base_dir` branch of `walk`).
